# .agents/memories — Repo Memory (dated files)

Parent law: root `AGENTS.md` `<REPO_MEMORY>` (entry format, retirement, hygiene). This file is the local contract for the folder.

## Layout

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `{date}-memory.txt` | One UTC day of durable knowledge — facts, decisions, gotchas, one bullet per entry |
| older `{date}-memory.txt` | The archive; read only when a current entry points back |

Files roll per UTC date and pair with `../comms/{date}-team.txt` — read both at orientation.

## Rules

1. **Append, don't rewrite.** `- HH:MM <fact>` as discovered; retire with `- HH:MM [RESOLVED] <fact> — <resolution>` appended in the same file. No entry stays wrong unqualified.
2. **Terse.** One line per entry; anchor inline (`bin/foo.sh: bar`) — no boilerplate, no source trailers.
3. **Commit on the task branch** — memory travels with push like every other `.agents/` record.
4. **Hygiene.** Scrub identifiers, credentials, and trajectories before commit.
5. **Boundary.** `../comms|tasks|suggestions|handoffs/` are the coordination system of record (claims, lifecycle, receipts); this folder holds knowledge only.

## Update After Editing

Any change to the memory scheme updates this file and root `AGENTS.md` `<REPO_MEMORY>` in the same task. Retired predecessors (removed 2026-09-23): `MEMORY.md` digest + `exports/` server snapshots.
